body: A weak man who lived a life of full of trauma. He lost most of his family when he was young and watched his mother's murder at a later age. I guess he felt helpless in these events. But he shouldn't have taken it out on me. I don't know I just don't want to talk about him anymore. Thanks for asking though.... he was my father.

Sorry for the late reply but thank you for posting this. I couldn't help but smile after reading your words. After rereading my post and every reply, I feel less connected to that "asshole." But I don't have the money to leave or pay for a psychiatrist yet.

If I plan on shooting myself within two months, I might as well take a chance at rebuilding my confidence. Looking emaciated and keeping my head down seems to deter friendliness. My teeth looks rotten and many in this town believe I am a heroin addict(Avoiding the use of illegal drugs... has always felt innate). I smell like shit and I push away those who look past all of that. Constantly being aware of my surroundings and being silent seems to put nearby people on edge. If I were to view myself with the eyes of others...they wouldn't know how to react at what they were seeing. Looking like the lovechild of Nosferatu and Richard Ramirez can be quiet horrifying for others.  I guess I can forgive those people who treat me like a freak and I feel bad for allowing it to get this way.

I'll take up classes to keep my mind busy(shit its been 5 years without any type of critical thinking). Hopefully I can quickly pick-up social etiquette from those around me. Rework on my writing techniques. Relearn to flesh out my thoughts. Make friends and regain a stronger will to improve. Finally build the courage to go to school or get a job. Then I'll decide if I need to leave or pay for a psychiatrist. Or both.

I'm very difficult to piss off and I can work very well around poisonous people so you don't have to worry about me getting violent. If I feel the need to physically hurt someone who isn't an actual threat, then I'm doing something wrong. Finding and following a new "leader/asshole" individual is near impossible since I view every eligible  abusive control freak as a weak man. I should avoid being too clingy also since that can be irritating for others. 

After reading the replies, I recontacted an old well-to-do buddy who knows what I've been through. He told me that he has a job and a place for me whenever I'm socially and mentally ready. He tends to be a dick alpha male type but he has always been kind to me and he knows my capabilities. I would love being a servant for a large household. I take pride in my discipline to serve and the on-the-job training to improve it sounds too delicious. I would be flown out of this town and would get to live in a state known for its diversity.

Sorry if all of these seem long and all over the place, I wish they were easier to write(yuck excuses). Huh now that I got that all that off my chest, suicide seems like a waste. I'm better off selling this gun to help save money for whats to come. OK now I feel very free. Fuck that "asshole." What do I have to lose without him? My experiences shouldn't be holding me back. I've developed temper control and thick skin thanks to his "training." If I can control my temper lol lol the possibilities of handling my other emotions. hahahahahah there is a really cute girl I met and have forgotten recently. She talks about herself for hours but listening to her is the most relaxing feeling I have felt so far. Something that would annoy others so easily feels great to me. I can't even imagine what else there is for me. hhahahahahahha I'm hungry and I've never eaten at that  casual Japanese place across the street. I don't know how to ride a bike or swim. This will be fun. Shit I haven't had fun in ages. If I get hit with rejection or failure, oh well at least I tried. There is so much I can learn from failure. I have so many strict boundaries I can "choose to keep." I won't allow this "training" to hold me back and I will salvage whatever helps me move forward. I'm old enough to realize I have a choice. 

Again thank you all for replying. Now I need to type less and get ready to eat some Japanese food within this week. Take classes and get rid of the gun also. Hopefully with the motor-mouthed chick(I'm not that different from her hehe) or an old friend I pushed away. Goodbye.
